text: カギは　だれが　もってるのかなー？

structure.jp: だれが　もってるの

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, a state that is going on. もってる = 'is holding, has'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means the speaker is wondering aloud. だれが　もってるのかなー = 'I wonder who has it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の after a verb in a question shows the speaker wants the story behind something. もってるの = 'is it that someone has it'.
